Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s prior search results, stating that the place of death was not provided when the snippets already indicated “Paris” from multiple sources (Wikipedia, IMDb, Kinorium). This led to continued reliance on search snippets instead of opening and verifying authoritative pages, and ultimately to a premature conclusion selecting “Boulogne-Billancourt” without reconciling the contradiction—resulting in an incorrect or at least unverified final answer.
